problem: Older SSH clients lack multi-device sync and team collaboration for sharing servers and snippets.
business_model: Freemium SaaS subscriptions for individuals and teams

founders.name: Roman Kudiyarov
previous_startups: IT businesses in Siberia and New Zealand with Lyfar (over a decade)

founders.name: Dmitry Lyfar
previous_startups: IT businesses in Siberia and New Zealand with Kudiyarov (over a decade)

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-platform desktop and mobile clients with end-to-end encrypted vault sync.

defensibility.rationale: Synced vault and team sharing create some lock-in; SSH clients are otherwise easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; remains independent and active.

market_need_then: June 2019 coverage: 11,000+ network engineers and DevOps users including staff at SpaceX, Disney and Cisco.

pivots.why: Stated use of seed funds, per NZ Entrepreneur

outcome_analysis: Termius grew from an internal tool into an SSH client with 11,000 users by mid 2019 and raised a 4.1 NZ million dollar seed after YC, then expanded toward teams. It remains active with about 35 staff; no later rounds or exit were found, so funding coverage is partial.
notes: Seed US$2.7M (NZ$4.1M) investors unnamed in the sources read. Competitors not named in sources; left empty. The pivot entry is an expansion of scope, not a true pivot.
